name: hr_benefits
summary: Benefit plans + eligibility, enrolments with dependents + employer contributions, allowance/reimbursement approvals, band-checked salary changes, compensation review cycles
description: Production benefits and compensation governance on top of the hr anchor without migrating any table, reusing the F1 job-grade salary bands. Benefit plans carry eligibility rules (minimum tenure, department) and an employer-contribution formula (fixed or percentage-of-salary with an optional cap) plus an employee contribution rate; enrolments are confirmed through a maker-checker gate that re-validates eligibility and coverage of dependents; allowances and reimbursements are effective-dated requests approved under maker-checker; promotion / salary changes are band-checked against the target grade and applied only via a manager maker-checker approval; and compensation review cycles scope proposed increases to a period, a department and a budget cap, with line recommendations and approvals respecting that cap. No amount here ever silently posts into payroll (blueprint guardrail): every value-bearing step records a guarded, auditable approval outcome. Navigated under the single HR app.
author: Nexa
